thread:
alex: Heads-up — canary preflight flagged a prompt-suite regression vs baseline. ROUGE-L down ~3.8%, failure threshold is -2.0%. Blocking promotion until we decide.

deploybot: [preflight summary] route: canary-eu, model: redwood/summarizer@v1.5.0, tests: prompt-suite-2026-03, status: FAIL, delta: -3.8% ROUGE-L, top-fail-case: 'long-thread-summary' (36% -> 28%).
jordan: Ugh. Is this correlated with quant change or recent tokenizer tweak?
tang: I ran a quick diff on the canary logs — KV cache hit rates normal. Looks like a generation tuning (temp/penalty) drift in v1.5.0 compared to v1.4.2.
priya: What's the user-visible impact? Are these edge cases or common flows? Any customer-facing incidents?
jordan: Mostly longer multi-turn threads in our beta test set. Not many production hits yet but our sample weights those flows. Could be noticeable in summarizer feature for Docs.
marc: Options: 1) Pin route back to v1.4.2 for canary-eu and continue rollout elsewhere. 2) Rollback canary entirely. 3) Approve with mitigations (adjust temp / fallback to compact summaries). We need signoff within the change window (ends in 90 mins).
alex: I'm leaning to pin canary-eu to v1.4.2 and run a focused bisect on v1.5.0 params. Minimizes blast radius and buys time.
tang: Agree. We should also run the prompt-suite with quantized variant (q4) to check if quantization interacts badly. I'll kick that off.
marc: @alex please post the pin command here so ops can execute. If done, I'll update the release notes and unpublish the canary flag.
alex: ops command to pin: ```rdwctl routes pin --route canary-eu --model redwood/summarizer@v1.4.2 --reason "preflight regression 3.8% ROUGE-L"```
deploybot: received command: rdwctl routes pin --route canary-eu --model redwood/summarizer@v1.4.2
deploybot: action result: SUCCESS, route canary-eu now serving redwood/summarizer@v1.4.2 (rolled back at 1768005187)
priya: Thanks — product side: we'll pause the EU marketing push and notify EU beta customers that a minor tweak prevented promotion. No incident page needed.
jordan: Tang — share bisect results in #eng-ml when ready. If it's a param drift we can try a hotfix build with previous params on v1.5.0.
tang: Will do. Kicking off bisect + q4 run now. ETA ~45m.
marc: I'll mark this as gated in the release tracker and close the canary window. If bisect points to a clear regression fix, we can schedule a hotfix patch and re-promote under the next window.
alex: Agreed. Closing loop: canary-eu pinned, rollout paused, bisect running. Resolving here unless new data arrives. :white_check_mark:
